text: The major of Electronic information is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates electronic science, information technology, communication engineering and computer technology, focusing on the design, development and application of electronic devices and information systems. The course is based on circuit analysis, signal processing and communication principles, aiming to cultivate students' mastery of core technologies in electronic hardware design (such as PCB circuit boards, embedded systems), software programming (such as C/C++, Python), and information transmission and processing, and to develop them into compound engineering talents with innovative and practical abilities
